title: A Cat on a Sun Hat
lines: Liz has a sun hat on a rug.
A tan cat hops up and naps on a hat.
"A cat is on the hat!" said Liz.
"Do not tap the cat," said Zeb.
Zeb gets a pan and taps on it.
The cat hops up and runs to a tub.
Liz has the hat. A mud dot is on top.
Liz rubs at the mud dot.
"The cat can have the rug," said Zeb.
scoring_note: This passage says "do not". Decodability forbids apostrophes. A child who reads "don't" is reading for meaning — do not score it an error.
